name: Hollow Mirror Saint
lore: An Empyrean-shaped absence that reflects protection into imprisonment; it proves order can be imitated without mercy.
visualDescription: Winglike negative-space guardian with broken halo mirror, porcelain mask fragments, chain-light without warmth.
mapBehavior: Creates shield zones that help Hollow units unless shattered by coordinated strikes.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; old wins should become easier as Titan level and gear rise.
scaling.eliteRemix: +12% hp, +10% damage, +1 mechanic layer, +2 tactical AI priority.
scaling.endgame: Dynamic scaling is capped at player effective level +8; adds mechanics before raw hp.
scaling.levelFormula: hp = baseHp * (1 + 0.045 * missionLevel); damage = baseDamage * (1 + 0.035 * missionLevel), capped by tier budget

aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Every major action has a telegraph or setup turn unless spawned as a minor swarmer.

balanceNotes: Harder solo tuning: Elite ELITE pressures one active Titan through behavior first, stats second; threatWeight 4.0 controls encounter budgets.
